name: Cold introduction
description: First, unsolicited introduction to a prospect who has had no previous contact with Vitalos.
subject: A short introduction from Vitalos
preheader: Who we are, where we help, and an easy way to say no thanks.
reason: We are contacting you because {{organisation}} works in an area where we help organisations like yours. You can opt out at any time.

blocks.text:
Hi {{first_name}},

I am getting in touch because Vitalos works with organisations like {{organisation}} on technology decisions and delivery, and I thought a brief introduction might be useful.

We are a UK technology consulting, engineering and digital transformation company. Our work usually falls into a few areas:
- Clarifying transformation choices, roadmaps and architecture before expensive execution
- Building and modernising production software, platforms and integrations
- Taking AI and data from early opportunity through to production

If any of this is on your agenda, I would be glad to arrange a short conversation to understand your priorities. There is no obligation, and if the timing is wrong, a one-line reply is enough and I will not follow up.

name: Cold follow-up 1
description: First follow-up to a cold introduction that has had no reply, offering a concrete starting point.

reason: We are contacting you because {{organisation}} works in an area where we help organisations like yours. You can opt out at any time.

blocks.text:
Hi {{first_name}},

I wrote recently with a brief introduction to Vitalos. Inboxes are busy, so I wanted to follow up once with something more specific.

Before committing budget to a significant change, some leaders find it helpful to get an independent view of where they stand. That is what our Technology Health Assessment and Digital Transformation Discovery are designed to provide: a clear picture of the current position and a prioritised view of what to do next.

If that would be useful for {{organisation}}, I would be happy to talk it through. If not, just let me know and I will close the thread.

name: Cold follow-up 2
description: Second follow-up to a cold introduction, offering a different angle focused on delivery and reliability.
subject: A different angle for {{organisation}}
preheader: In case the pressing issue is a system or project rather than a strategy.
reason: We are contacting you because {{organisation}} works in an area where we help organisations like yours. You can opt out at any time.

blocks.text:
Hi {{first_name}},

I appreciate you may not have had time to reply to my earlier notes, so I will keep this short.

Not every organisation needs a strategy exercise. Sometimes the pressing issue is a system that has become hard to change, an integration that keeps breaking, or a project that has lost momentum. Vitalos Engineering works on exactly these problems, through Application Modernisation, Systems Integration and, where a project needs steadying, Engineering Rescue.

If any of that sounds familiar, a short call is the quickest way to find out whether we can help. If not, there is no need to reply.

reason: We are contacting you because {{organisation}} works in an area where we help organisations like yours. You can opt out at any time.

blocks.text:
Hi {{first_name}},

I have written a few times about how Vitalos might support {{organisation}}, and I do not want to keep filling your inbox. This will be my last email on the subject.

If the timing is wrong, or this simply is not a priority, that is completely understandable. Should things change, you can reach me directly at {{sender_email}}, or find out more about our work at vitalos.co.uk.

Thank you for your time, and I wish you and the team well.

Hi {{first_name}},

A mutual contact suggested I get in touch, as they thought Vitalos might be helpful to {{organisation}}. I am grateful for the introduction and wanted to reach out personally.

Vitalos is a UK technology consulting, engineering and digital transformation company. We help organisations make clear technology decisions, then build, modernise and run the systems that follow from them.

I would welcome a short conversation to understand what you are working on and whether there is a sensible way for us to help. If now is not the right time, simply let me know and I will leave it there.

Hi {{first_name}},

I am getting in touch to explore whether there might be value in Vitalos and {{organisation}} working together.

Vitalos is a UK technology company working across five practices: Consulting, Engineering, AI & Data, Experience and Managed Services. From what I understand of your work, our strengths may complement yours. There could be opportunities to refer clients to one another, or to collaborate where a project needs both sets of skills.

If this is of interest, I would suggest an informal call to compare notes on the organisations we each serve and the gaps we each see. If it is not a fit, a quick reply would be appreciated so that I do not follow up unnecessarily.
